links.comparator_used: Basic ChatGPT-4.0 with a simple prompt versus custom 'DermDecoder' GPT with a structured 489-word prompt
links.outcome: Expert-rated factualness, completeness and potential harm of simplified dermatopathology reports
links.effect: Mean ratings ranged 1.27-1.63 (factualness/completeness) and 1.31-1.83 (harmfulness). DermDecoder was significantly worse for completeness in psoriasis (t = -2.79, p = 0.007) and for harmfulness in molluscum contagiosum (p = 0.049) and melanoma in situ (p = 0.048).
links.tradeoff: DermDecoder gave generic education disconnected from the pathological findings. The basic prompt preserved details but lacked clinical context. Human-in-the-loop oversight is still needed.
links.quote: Prompt engineering offered no advantage over basic AI usage in balancing professional accuracy with patient accessibility, necessitating human-in-the-loop oversight for AI-generated explanations.

design_hint: structured prompt engineering (custom GPT with detailed prompt) for patient-facing report simplification
